serverInfo.name: trippovention-webmcp
serverInfo.title: Trippovention WebMCP (static site)
serverInfo.description: Optional browser WebMCP tools on the homepage only. Full travel catalog is in llms.txt, llms-full.txt, and HTML pages. No MCP SSE or REST API.

tools.name: search_travel_packages
tools.description: Search Trippovention international and domestic travel packages by destination or keyword

query.description: Destination name, activity, or keyword (e.g., "Dubai", "Bali honeymoon", "Europe tour", "Rishikesh yoga")

tools.name: get_package_details
tools.description: Retrieve full itinerary details, inclusions, and overview for a specific Trippovention travel package

packageName.description: Name of the travel package or destination (e.g. "Dubai", "Bali", "Rishikesh")

tools.name: get_visa_requirements
tools.description: Retrieve visa application requirements, processing timeline, and required documents for travel destinations

tools.name: submit_travel_inquiry
tools.description: Submit a custom travel inquiry or request expert callback for tailored holiday package planning
